name: Mahansh Gaur - Executive Cover Letter
content:
I am writing to express my strong enthusiasm for the Software Engineering / AI Systems Engineer role. As a final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science & Engineering (IoT) graduating in 2027 and winner of the Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025, I bring hands-on experience designing production-grade backend systems, automated ingestion pipelines, and rigorous test automation suites.

Throughout my engineering work, I have focused on building measurable, high-availability software architectures:
• AI Backend & Async Pipelines: Engineered an end-to-end product ingestion pipeline using FastAPI, Celery, Redis, and MongoDB with structured Gemini outputs, automated deduplication, and rate-limit resilience.
• Computer Vision & Embedded Robotics: Designed an autonomous 6-DOF pick-and-place robotic arm system with OpenCV color segmentation and visual servoing, slashing memory footprint by 75% on Raspberry Pi 4B.
• Testing & CI/CD Systems: Architected AmitAstro with 170+ automated tests across Vitest, Supertest, and Playwright, validating cross-database behavior (SQLite & PostgreSQL) via GitHub Actions CI service containers.

My core competencies in Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Distributed Systems directly align with your engineering objectives. I thrive in high-ownership engineering environments and look forward to contributing immediately to your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications in an interview.
